name: osric_notes
speaker: Osric's daybook
notes: The book on the lectern in the cellar under the smithy (docs/PLAN_demons.md D2): the `readable` ref harrowby/smithy_notes opens it. Four pages; the last GRANTS the glyph summon_skerrick (Skerrick's name, D1's summon glyph) and LEARNS the name (world flag name:skerrick, which the entry reads to open at the name page the second time). Osric's voice: short, flat, a soldier who became a smith.

nodes.text: Hinges for Edric, paid. Nails for Maud, owing. Below the tally, in a smaller hand: What I learned on the ridge. Written so it is not lost with me. Burn this if I am dead.
THE RING. Salt and nothing else. Pour it from outside, one line, closed, no gap a mouse could pass. Not brine, not wet. Step over it, never on it. A broken ring is an open door.

THE PILES. The salt holds its hands as well as its feet. Sulfur by the ring: its fire stays in. Iron: it sits smaller, and binds cheaper. Quicksilver, in a dish: it cannot slip out. Keep the sulfur from the quicksilver. A candle at each quarter.
THE NAME. A small one. Grey, mean as a stoat. SKERRICK. Speak it into the ring from outside. Talk. Bargain. Send it home. Never let it out on a promise. I did, once.
The last page. One word, cut in hard and underlined twice: SKERRICK.
